facts.fact: Law 43/VIII/2013 creates the SNIAC, a central national civil identification system with a database of citizens, resident foreigners and stateless residents, fed from civil registry acts including births and deaths.

systems.country_label: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil
systems.platform: central civil identification database with PKI
systems.owner: Conselho de Gestão (coordinated by the registry and identification ministry)
